summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its May 21, 2026 General Meeting. Shareholders approved a distribution of USD 0.64 per share from available share premium, totaling between $130M and $200M. No tender or Dutch auction was used; it is a direct capital return. The board had conditioned the distribution on shareholder approval, which was obtained. All other resolutions, including board reappointments, also passed. The distribution is expected to be funded from share premium. Watch for the payment date and any subsequent capital actions; the risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a straightforward return of capital, not a tender or buyback.
